release_notes:
v14.2.2 Bug Fixes

• Gemini 2.0 Flash as default (2.5 Flash deprecated)
• Switchable Gemini model in Settings (2.0, 2.0 Lite, 2.5 legacy, 3.8)
• Fixed audio transcription for Python 3.14 (ffmpeg extraction fallback)
• Improved keyframe extraction — 3 frames at 25/50/75% for short clips
• Mac system tools installer — one-click Homebrew install for ffmpeg/exiftool
• DB resilience and thread-safety improvements
